        <p>Short version first. Tap “Show all details” for the full list.</p>
        <ul class="included-list">
          <li>“From Zero to Hero” kite camp – €740 per person.</li>
          <li>8 days / 7 nights in our Fisherman's Cabana (double occupancy, single with surcharge).</li>
          <li>Full board: tropical fruits, Sri Lankan rice &amp; curry lunch, special dinners, tea/coffee &amp; drinking water.</li>
          <li>Zero to Hero kite camp: 12 hours intensive training (max. 2 students per group).</li>
        </ul>
        <div class="included-extra" id="included-extra">
          <ul class="included-list" style="margin-top:4px;">
            <li>2 days of kite rental at the end – ride in both directions on your own.</li>
            <li>Transfers to the kiting beach in our house boat.</li>
            <li>Airport pickup &amp; drop-off in our old-school Volkswagen surfer van (valid for double bookings / availability of the vehicle).</li>
            <li>Kite safari to Dream Spot when booked as a double.</li>
          </ul>

        <h2>Your 7-Day Journey</h2>
        <p>Short, focused time on the water – with space in between to rest, reflect and reconnect.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="timeline">
        <div class="timeline-card">
          <strong>Day 1–2</strong>
          Wind &amp; spot intro, basic theory, kite control and safety. First body drags in the lagoon.
        </div>
        <div class="timeline-card">
          <strong>Day 3–4</strong>
          Getting on the board, Building confidence and spending more time on the board. Water starts and first rides.
        </div>
        <div class="timeline-card">
          <strong>Day 5–7</strong>
          Independent riding, refining technique and enjoying the lagoon at your rhythm.
        </div>
